changes.old: - A run can be repeated at any time. A project changes (it gains a database, a web surface or a new tracker) and Phoenix memory changes (a new standard or template), and the set-up must follow both without a reinstall. The reason: a project can run `initialize` again when it changes.

changes.old: - How a project learns that a block changed. Each run of initialize reads through the memory tool, for each block in the list, the parts its selection finds in Phoenix memory now. A part the list holds that now reads differently is changed. A part the selection now finds that the list does not hold is added. A part the list holds that the selection no longer finds is taken out. The brief names each one under its block. The reason: initialize can run again to take in changes.
